summary: George Russell's pole position ambitions collide with championship leader Kimi Antonelli's grid penalty after a costly qualifying crash, reshaping Mercedes' strategic approach at Baku's high-speed street circuit. McLaren's concerning pace deficit in practice sessions threatens to derail Lando Norris' title charge, opening the door for rivals to capitalize on the Woking team's struggles. A strong result here could prove decisive in the championship battle, with Antonelli fighting from 16th and Russell positioned to maximize points from pole.
